'''Rhonda Krempa''' (born '''Natasha Charles Parker Malinsky''') is an American voice actress who worked for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

== Pokémon roles ==
Krempa joined the series during [[S09|the ninth season]], when {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|took over the dubbing and distribution of the series]]. She left the series in [[S13|the thirteenth season]], with both her main roles of {{si|Kenny}} and {{si|Rhonda}} going to [[Erica Schroeder|Bella Hudson]].
